The moving averages are all pointing up, the MACD is bullish, the Fibonacci retracement levels are all above the current price, the Bollinger Bands are widening, and the RSI is above 50. All of these indicators suggest that the bulls are in control of the market and that the price is likely to continue to rise. Of course, there is no guarantee that this will happen, but the technical analysis does provide some evidence to support this conclusion. As always, it is important to do your own research before making any investment decisions.
